His son made a harsh film about him. His reply was perfect.

Kevin explains how a reporter asked Deepak Chopra about a scathing documentary his son made. Deepak said his son didn't make a film about him. He made a film about himself.

Kevin's point: what you see in others is often what is in you. He describes authors who write about love and label every ex, never noticing that three fingers are pointing back at themselves.

What do you keep pointing at in other people?
